name: Dreaming
overview: Scripture reveals that dreaming can be a means by which God communicates, especially to prophets and His people, as seen in Numbers 12:6 where the LORD speaks through dreams and visions. Joel 2:28 and Acts 2:17 emphasize that in the last days, God will pour out His Spirit so that old men will dream dreams, signifying divine revelation. However, Ecclesiastes cautions that many dreams can be meaningless or arise from worldly distractions, urging believers to maintain a reverent fear of God amid the multitude of dreams and words.
